metadata.description: ButterStack's collection of domain-specific gamedev agents for Claude Code.

plugins.name: perforce
plugins.description: Observe, analyze, and safely operate a Perforce / Helix Core (p4/p4d) system - read-first, gamedev-focused.

plugins.name: unreal
plugins.description: Observe, diagnose, and safely operate an Unreal Engine project's build/cook/package pipeline and editor automation - read-first, gamedev-focused.

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Observe, diagnose, and safely operate a Unity project's CLI build pipeline via the standalone Unity CLI - read-first, gamedev-focused, with Editor-version routing (2022 LTS batchmode vs Unity 6), plus the verified Unity 6 Pipeline live-Editor control surface and MCP (140 tools, Unity's own confirm/dry_run gates).

plugins.name: lore
plugins.description: Observe, analyze, and safely operate an Epic Games Lore version control system (the `lore` CLI, formerly Unreal Revision Control) - read-first, gamedev-focused.

plugins.name: jenkins
plugins.description: Observe, operate, and safely diagnose a Jenkins CI/CD server. Read-first; pairs with the Perforce agent's change-commit build loop.
